workers_per_cpu_quota.desc: This parameter * tenant max_cpu = maximum number of threads that can be allocated to the tenant. This maximum thread count is allocated and available for use, not the maximum number of threads running simultaneously. This parameter generally does not require adjustment

net_thread_count.desc: Number of network threads for receiving client requests. Requires restart to take effect. Check MySQLIO thread usage efficiency via top -H: if usage rate > 90%, receiving threads may become a bottleneck, recommend increasing this parameter; if all threads < 50%, recommend decreasing this parameter to reduce thread switching overhead

enable_early_lock_release.desc: Enable early row lock release. Recommended to enable for hotspot row scenarios

enable_monotonic_weak_read.desc: Enable monotonic read. Recommended to disable for performance scenarios

enable_perf_event.desc: Enable information collection. Must be enabled in production environment, can be disabled as appropriate in performance testing scenarios

enable_record_trace_log.desc: Enable Trace Log function. In production environment with Perf Event and SQL Audit enabled, this parameter can be disabled

syslog_level.desc: Log level for system logs. Recommended to set to PERF in performance scenarios to reduce non-critical log output

clog_sync_time_warn_threshold.desc: Print warning logs when log synchronization time exceeds a certain threshold, adjustable via this configuration item. Recommended to increase, but note it may affect troubleshooting of slow Clog synchronization issues

builtin_db_data_verify_cycle.desc: Macro block inspection cycle parameter. When set to 0, inspection is disabled. Recommended to set to 0 in performance-related scenarios to reduce system overhead

disk_io_thread_count.desc: Disk I/O thread count, must be an even number. Can be adjusted appropriately according to I/O pressure

enable_async_syslog.desc: Enable asynchronous log output. Recommended to set to True in performance scenarios to reduce performance impact of log printing

fuse_row_cache_priority.desc: Priority of fused row cache in KV cache. Recommended to set greater than 1 to avoid premature cache replacement and improve query performance

micro_block_merge_verify_level.desc: Macro block verification level, 0 means no verification. Can be set to 0 in performance scenarios, but not recommended to modify in production systems

compaction_low_thread_score.desc: Concurrent thread count for low priority Compaction (mainly for Major SSTable). Default 0 means 6 concurrent threads, can be increased appropriately according to load to improve merge speed

compaction_mid_thread_score.desc: Concurrent thread count for medium priority Compaction (mainly for Minor SSTable). Default 0 means 6 concurrent threads, can be increased appropriately according to load to improve merge efficiency

compaction_high_thread_score.desc: Concurrent thread count for high priority Compaction (mainly for Mini SSTable). Default 0 means 6 concurrent threads, can be increased appropriately according to system pressure

ob_proxy_readonly_transaction_routing_po.desc: Controls whether Proxy routing for transactions is affected by read-only statements. Recommended to set to False, meaning based on the first actual transaction-opening statement

work_thread_num.desc: Number of worker threads for OBProxy, significantly affects CPU usage, default value is 128. Can be dynamically adjusted according to CPU count, requires restart after change

task_thread_num.desc: Number of background task threads for OBProxy (such as pulling rslist), default value is 2. Recommended to keep default value

block_thread_num.desc: Number of block threads for OBProxy, default value is 1. Recommended to keep default value

grpc_thread_num.desc: Number of gRPC threads for OBProxy, default value is 8. Recommended to keep default value

net_accept_threads.desc: Number of threads executing accept, default value is 2. Recommended to keep default value

automatic_match_work_thread.desc: Whether to automatically adjust worker thread count based on CPU count. When true, upper limit is work_thread_num, suitable for mixed deployment; when false, uses fixed value, suitable for exclusive deployment

enable_compression_protocol.desc: Whether to enable compression protocol to reduce OBProxy CPU usage. Recommended to configure as False. Note: This parameter has been deprecated since V4.3.4

server_tcp_user_timeout.desc: TCP user timeout for connections between OBProxy and OBServer (unit: seconds). Default value is 0, recommended to keep default value

client_tcp_user_timeout.desc: TCP user timeout for connections between OBProxy and Client (unit: seconds). Default value is 0, recommended to keep default value

client_max_connections.desc: Maximum client connections accepted by OBProxy, default value is 8192. Recommended to keep default value

connect_observer_max_retries.desc: Maximum retry count for OBProxy reconnecting to OBServer, default value is 3. Recommended to keep default value

observer_query_timeout_delta.desc: Network transmission delay compensation, additional time added to OBServer's ob_query_timeout (unit: seconds). Default value is 20, range [1,39]. Recommended to keep default value

sock_option_flag_out.desc: TCP parameters between OBProxy and OBServer (bit control for no_delay, keepalive, linger_on). Default values vary by version: V1.8.x recommended 3, V3.x recommended to keep default value

server_tcp_keepidle.desc: TCP idle time before starting keepalive between OBProxy and OBServer (seconds). Default value is 5, recommended to keep default value

server_tcp_keepintvl.desc: TCP keepalive probe interval between OBProxy and OBServer (seconds). Default value is 5, recommended to keep default value

server_tcp_keepcnt.desc: Maximum number of keepalive packets sent for TCP between OBProxy and OBServer, default value is 5. Recommended to keep default value

client_sock_option_flag_out.desc: TCP parameters between client and OBProxy (bit control for no_delay, keepalive, linger_on). V1.8.x default 0, V3.x default 2, recommended to set to 3 to enable no_delay and linger_on

client_tcp_keepidle.desc: TCP idle time before starting keepalive between client and OBProxy (seconds). Default value is 5, recommended to keep default value

client_tcp_keepintvl.desc: TCP keepalive probe interval between client and OBProxy (seconds). Default value is 5, recommended to keep default value

client_tcp_keepcnt.desc: Maximum number of keepalive packets sent for TCP between client and OBProxy, default value is 5. Recommended to keep default value

enable_index_route.desc: Whether to enable global index table routing based on global index keys. Default True, recommended to keep default value

enable_pl_route.desc: Whether to enable PL routing. Default True, recommended to disable (False) in performance scenarios

enable_reroute.desc: Whether to enable secondary routing. Takes effect after enabling OceanBase 2.0 protocol (enable_ob_protocol_v2). Default False, recommended to keep default value

enable_partition_table_route.desc: Whether to enable partition table routing. Default True, recommended to keep default value

server_routing_mode.desc: OBProxy routing mode. Includes oceanbase (default), random, mock, mysql, etc. Recommended to keep default value

enable_ob_protocol_v2.desc: Whether to enable OceanBase 2.0 protocol between OBProxy and OBServer (based on MySQL compression protocol). Default False, recommended to keep default value

routing_cache_mem_limited.desc: Sets memory limit for OBProxy routing cache (table cache, address cache, etc.). Default value 128 MB, range [1KB, 100G], recommended to keep default value

enable_bad_route_reject.desc: Whether to reject unroutable requests. Default False, recommended to keep default value
